changeSet.author: kabipay-dev

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kabipay_ops.module WHERE UPPER(TRIM(code)) = 'EMPLOYEE'

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_prejoining_employee_parent ON "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_prejoining_document_type_parent ON "${schema}".document_type(tenant_id,id); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".prejoining_config ( tenant_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, config JSONB NOT NULL, updated_by UUID NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".prejoining_candidate ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','APPROVED','JOINED','CANCELLED')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 0), config JSONB NOT NULL, answers JSONB NOT NULL, feedback TEXT, invitation_digest TEXT, expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, employee_id UUID, created_by UUID NOT NULL, updated_by UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, UNIQUE(tenant_id,id), UNIQUE(tenant_id,employee_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,created_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,employee_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id), CHECK((status='JOINED') = (employee_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(status NOT IN ('JOINED','CANCELLED') OR invitation_digest IS NULL) ); CREATE INDEX idx_prejoining_candidate_queue ON "${schema}".prejoining_candidate(tenant_id,status,created_at DESC,id); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".prejoining_event ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, candidate_id UUID NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, actor_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, UNIQUE(tenant_id,candidate_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".prejoining_candidate(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,actor_id) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".prejoining_document ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, candidate_id UUID NOT NULL, requirement_id UUID NOT NULL, document_type_id UUID NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, bytes BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760), is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, file_storage_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, CHECK(mime_type IN ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png')), UNIQUE(tenant_id,file_storage_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".prejoining_candidate(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,document_type_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".document_type(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,file_storage_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".file_storage(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_prejoining_current_document ON "${schema}".prejoining_document(tenant_id,candidate_id,requirement_id) WHERE is_current; INSERT INTO "${schema}".permission(id,resource,action,module_id,description,created_at,updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(),'prejoining',v.action,m.id,v.description,NOW(),NOW() FROM (VALUES ('manage','Configure and invite pre-joining candidates'),('review','Review and confirm pre-joining candidates')) v(action,description) JOIN kabipay_ops.module m ON UPPER(TRIM(m.code)) = 'EMPLOYEE' WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".permission p WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.resource))='prejoining' AND LOWER(TRIM(p.action))=v.action);
